summary.headline: FY26 revenue rose 35% to INR1,525 crore and PAT 56%, but Q4 margin fell 70-80 bps on steel prices; FY27 guided to 30% Prefab growth.
summary.overview: Management reported FY26 as its first full year as a listed company, with revenue up 35% to INR1,525 crore, PAT up 56%, and about INR107-108 crore of debt repaid. Free operating cash flow was about INR135 crore, roughly 85% of EBITDA. Q4 margins fell 70-80 bps to about 9.7-10% because steel prices spiked after minimum import price and anti-dumping duties, and management says most customers (80%+ of contracts) have accepted price increases. Management guided FY27 Prefab growth of 30% (revenue INR1,920-1,950 crore), an order book target of INR2,000 crore plus, and margins of 10%+ / 10.5% plus.

financial_highlights.change: down 70-80 bps QoQ on steel prices
term loans of about INR70 crore plus working capital loans

financial_highlights.value: about 2.1% of debt; about INR8 crore per quarter
financial_highlights.change: expected to fall 20-25 bps in FY27

segments.name: Prefab (PEB / structural steel)
segments.commentary: FY26 PEB revenue about INR1,382 crore per analyst tally (confirmed by management); FY27 guided to 30% growth to INR1,925-1,950 crore. Margin guided at 10-10.5%, with packaging about 100 bps higher.

segments.name: Sandwich panel
segments.commentary: Mambattu line utilisation was about 25% in FY26; management targets 75-80% in FY27. FY26 sandwich panel volume about 5.18 lakh sq m, about INR65 crore of value at about INR1,300 per sq m; not reported separately.

segments.name: EPS / packaging
segments.commentary: Other revenue about INR131 crore in FY26 per analyst tally. Packaging margin about 100 bps above Prefab; management said EPS peak revenue is about INR200 crore.

guidance_outlook: FY27 Prefab revenue growth of 30%, to INR1,920-1,950 crore.
FY27 order booking target of INR2,000 crore plus (FY26 booking INR1,590 crore).
EBITDA margin guided at 10%+ throughout FY27, within the 10.5-11.5% range; Q1 may see a small hit.
Finance cost to fall 20-25 bps in FY27; PAT margin could reach about 6.5% per management.
FY27 capex about INR150 crore; end-FY27 PEB capacity about 2,20,000 MT and sandwich panel capacity about 21.1 lakh sq m.
Management expects debt-free status over time; credit rating improved.
capex_capacity: PEB capacity 1,47,000 MT today; Mambattu line 2 commissioned (second Mambattu line was described as in execution and due next quarter), taking PEB capacity to about 1,70,000 MT with Ghiloth.

Ghiloth (Noida/Rajasthan) continuous sandwich panel line: capex about INR102 crore (about INR90 crore for the panel line), commercial production Oct-Nov 2026 (Q3 FY27); adds about 8 lakh sq m panel capacity, taking panel capacity to about 21.1 lakh sq m.

Gujarat (Vithlapur) greenfield: first phase about 50,000 MT PEB; capex about INR100-110 crore (about INR38 crore land spent, INR60-65 crore balance); commissioning by end Q4 FY27, meaningful utilisation from FY28.
Q4 FY26 utilisation 83% (up from 58% in Q1, 77% in Q2, 67% in Q3); management says 70-75% is a strong quarterly level, peak about 83-84%.
Asset turn about 5x overall; about 6x on Prefab excluding EPS. Gujarat peak revenue about INR500-600 crore.
demand_pricing: Order book INR1,117-1,127 crore, giving visibility of about 6-8 months; management says 100% should execute within FY27 (5-10% at risk from EC or funding delays).
New-age sectors (renewables, data centres, semiconductors, logistics, EV) were 35-38% of the order book as of 1 April; repeat customers 35-40% of orders.
Pipeline about INR5,000 crore, win rate 15-20%; management expects Q1 FY27 order booking to be strong.
Steel price spike in March 2026 driven by minimum import price and anti-dumping duties; price increases obtained from most customers, but not 100% pass-through.
Competition: three to four large players; management says margin cannot be commanded on differentiation, so growth and utilisation are prioritised.
West India share of order book fell from about 30% (FY25) to 17-18% (FY26); Gujarat plant to address this.

qa_highlights.question: Is management chasing growth by adding capacity ahead of confirmed orders?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said capacity is being added against demand; past South capacity was absorbed within 18 months, and Gujarat is expected to follow the same pattern.

qa_highlights.question: Will margins face pressure in FY27 and from steel costs in Q1-Q2?
qa_highlights.answer: Margins guided at 10%+ for FY27; Q1 may see a little impact, Q2 not major. Price increases were secured on 80%+ of contracts, and about 32,000 tons of inventory bought at older prices covers Q1.

qa_highlights.question: Revenue target and margin guidance for FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: Prefab revenue target INR1,920-1,950 crore (30% growth); margins 10%+, with no margin expansion expected this year.

qa_highlights.question: Is the order book executable in FY27 and what is the order inflow run rate?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the full INR1,100 crore should be executed this year, with 5-10% at risk. Order target is INR2,000 crore plus; monthly run rate was not given because project inflow is lumpy.

qa_highlights.question: Will the sandwich panel line be utilised and at what margin?
qa_highlights.answer: Mambattu utilisation targeted at 75-80%; the line adds about INR70-90 crore revenue and carries margins slightly above structural steel. Order book of 4 lakh sq m is about 75% captive and 25% external.

qa_highlights.question: Why is West revenue share falling and is market share being lost?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said share is not lost; South capacity drove the mix. West freight is currently subsidised, and a Gujarat plant is expected to lift West share.

qa_highlights.question: What are the Gujarat unit economics and funding?
qa_highlights.answer: Peak revenue INR500-600 crore on 50,000 MT; capex INR100-110 crore, funded from IPO proceeds and cash on hand. Ramp-up takes time.

risks_watch: Steel price volatility and pass-through (not 100%); Q4 margin already down 70-80 bps.
Sandwich panel line utilisation (25% in FY26) must reach 75-80% for the Mambattu asset to pay back.
Execution of new capacity: Ghiloth in Q3 FY27, Gujarat by Q4 FY27 with ramp-up after; Mambattu line 2 timing has been described inconsistently.
Order book target of INR2,000 crore requires a strong Q1 FY27; the pipeline is about INR5,000 crore at a 15-20% win rate.
Receivables rose to about 62-63 days; the target is 60 days.
Export business is small (Bhutan, Nepal, a few Africa projects); the focus is domestic.
summary.management_tone: Confident and promotional on growth, capacity and cash generation, but candid on the sandwich panel shortfall. Management was evasive on segment margins and product-level revenue, and gave loose or inconsistent answers on order-book run rate and capacity timing.
key_quotes: So we said we will deliver, and we have delivered. We said we'll do it, and we have done it.

And now with the new leadership in place, with the structured -- restructured sales team and sharper market focus, I believe that this year we'll be able to utilize a substantial portion of our new sandwich panel line
Yes, this entire order book of INR1,100 plus crores has to be executed within this year.
We are compounded at 36% for the last consecutive five years.

adds.what: Mambattu PEB line 2 (takes PEB capacity to ~1,70,000 MT with Ghiloth)
Ghiloth continuous sandwich panel line adding ~8 lakh sq m (panel capacity to ~21.1 lakh sq m)

growth.why: Management guides Prefab revenue up 30% to INR1,920-1,950 cr in FY27, backed by a INR1,117-1,127 cr order book (6-8 months visibility), a INR2,000 cr+ FY27 booking target, and capacity additions (PEB to ~2.2 lakh MT, panel to ~21.1 lakh sq m) with ~INR150 cr FY27 capex, though the Gujarat plant only contributes from FY28.
